description: 20 Uttar Pradesh test households for Haq. Expected schemes were derived from the official source listed on each item; every expected answer is marked needs_human_check=true for spot-checking. Scoring is at household + scheme level. 'acceptable_extra' schemes are plausible but optional (insurance/contributory products, or eligibility that depends on facts not in the profile): predicting them is not a false positive and missing them is not a false negative. An expected item with 'any_of' is satisfied by any one of the listed scheme ids.

PMAY-G: rural households that are houseless or living in kutcha / dilapidated houses (Awaas+ survey).
UP Pre-matric (class 9-10) and Post-matric (11 and above) scholarship for students of UP families within the category income limit. Case note: class 11 -> post-matric
